metadata.description: Design review tooling for UI work, as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: design-toolkit
plugins.description: Design review tooling for UI work. Founding skill: design-spec, which makes the review material for a UI change: a quick card (one composed image) or a full sheet (a claude.ai Artifact republished each round), built from a state inventory checked against the server contract and captured headless at fixed viewports, 2x, in light and dark. ui-inspect measures the screen first: overflow, clipped or covered text, contrast, and font faults, at the same viewports and themes. design-audit lists what is generic or broken on an existing screen, in the order to fix it. clean-copy cuts interface copy that should not exist and shapes what survives, error messages included.
